caption_L1: This bar chart is labeled Circulation of selected large daily newspapers in Finland in 2019. The x-axis plots Number of copies on linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 350,000 while the y-axis shows newspaper on categorical scale starting at Etelä-Saimaa and ending at Turun Sanomat.
caption_L2L3: Helsingin sanomat is the largest daily newspaper circulated in Finland with nearly 350,000 copies circulated. No other newspaper reaches 100,000 copies, with only three newspapers reaching just over 50,000 copies.
